item.title: Price hikes if Agus-Pulangi Hydro Complex is privatized: Consumer group

item.title: 16 Lanao royal houses set grand congress, name 2026 leaders
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — The 16 Royal Houses of Lanao, the highest traditional authority of the Lanao Sultanate, are set to convene the Lanao Sultanate Grand Congress alongside the 2026 induction of officers, a gathering aimed at strengthening unity and reinforcing the role of traditional leadership in peace-building and cultural preservation.
